snippet.title: The Cardian - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
🌒OFFMOON — Worth Discovering, Priced at a Dollar

The Cardian - Light the Shrines is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder where every step sets up your next strike! Predict enemy movements, plan your path, and place skill cards on the battlefield before the action unfolds. Build powerful card synergies, outsmart the incoming horde, and defend the last Shrines of Light!
